name: tracker-blocker-notes
goal: List unresolved blocker notes on in-progress items with no open flag

evidence: The existing blockers query selects blocked or flagged rows only. In-progress rows with a current blocker note and no flag should appear in the inbox.
Extended the repository method case and local blockers sync API case with note-only, legacy, recovered, parked and already flagged rows.
Expected the three note-only IDs, got an empty list. API total was 2 instead of 3.
Read the latest non-watchdog note for unflagged in-progress items and skip note entries during sync.
The unchanged repository and local API regression command passed all six cases.
